question: By what mantra and offerings should Viṣṇu be worshipped in this context?
premises: Viṣṇu is the object of worship.
The Viṣṇu-gāyatrī mantra is to be used.
Offerings include fragrance, flowers, and similar items.
inference: One should worship Viṣṇu with the Viṣṇu-gāyatrī mantra using fragrance, flowers, and other offerings.
plain_english: One should worship Viṣṇu with the Viṣṇu-gāyatrī, using fragrance, flowers, and other offerings.
